points.description: States that the best case for insertion sort is a sorted array (already sorted input).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if vaguely stated, e.g. 'when the data is in order' without saying array/sorted clearly, or with a minor error.

points.description: States the number of operations is N (linear, about N, the length of the array).

rubric.notes: Full marks need both: best case is a sorted array, and operations are about N (array length, linear/O(N)). Weight is on the sorted-array scenario; give part marks for vague wording. Answers giving N^2 or a reversed array as best case earn nothing for that point.
